mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.plan_code AS code, p.plan_name AS name, p.plan_level AS level, CASE WHEN p.is_free = 1 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS free, p.description, p.display_order, p.price, p.period_days, COALESCE( ( SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG( JSON_OBJECT( 'id', CAST(s.id AS CHAR), 'code', s.sku_code, 'name', s.sku_name, 'billingMode', s.billing_mode, 'periodUnit', s.period_unit, 'periodCount', s.period_count, 'price', s.price, 'originalPrice', s.original_price, 'refundDays', s.refund_days, 'displayOrder', s.display_order ) ) FROM ai_membership_plan_sku s WHERE s.plan_id = p.id AND s.status = 1 AND s.deleted = 0 ), JSON_ARRAY() ) AS skus_json, COALESCE( ( SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG( JSON_OBJECT( 'code', d.benefit_code, 'name', d.benefit_name, 'category', d.category, 'value', pb.benefit_value, 'valueType', d.value_type, 'unit', d.unit, 'resetType', d.reset_type, 'previewOnly', d.preview_only = 1, 'enabled', pb.enabled = 1 AND d.enabled = 1, 'description', d.description, 'displayOrder', d.display_order ) ) FROM ai_membership_plan_benefit pb JOIN ai_membership_benefit_definition d ON d.id = pb.benefit_id AND d.deleted = 0 WHERE pb.plan_id = p.id AND pb.deleted = 0 AND (pb.effective_time IS NULL OR pb.effective_time <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND (pb.expire_time IS NULL OR pb.expire_time > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ), JSON_ARRAY() ) AS benefits_json FROM ai_membership_plan p WHERE p.deleted = 0 AND p.status = 1 ORDER BY p.display_order, p.plan_level, p.id
